title: Prospective study of mobile ultrasound devices in senology
summary: In this study, the recorded data will be compared between the new mobile ultrasound device and and the already established ultrasound devices in order to check whether similar results can be achieved in terms of extent, location and complete removal of the tumor.

interventions.name: 1. use of point-of-care ultrasound (POCUS): The study focuses on the use of POCUS technology in breast surgery. POCUS refers to the targeted use of ultrasound by medical staff directly at the patient's bedside or in the patient care area to identify acute problems and implement immediate solutions.
